basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 22.' and it opens 'Vers. 22. Praeter terram sacerdotum, quae a rege tradita fuerat eis. Terra sacerdotum'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 22. Praeter terram sacerdotum, quae a rege tradita fuerat eis. Terra sacerdotum sancta est Ecclesia, in qua sunt veri sacerdotes, qui veram habent libertatem, et nullam spiritalis famis patiuntur penuriam, quia a rege Christo pabulo divini verbi aluntur.
